title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #5 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is darshan? (1 mark)
   A. Running around
   B. Leaving early
   C. Paying fees
   D. Looking at the murti with respect

2. Which of these should you do first when learning a mantra? (1 mark)
   A. Say it very fast
   B. Skip the words
   C. Listen to a teacher or recording for correct sounds
   D. Guess the words

3. Which words begin the well-known Saraswati Vandana? (1 mark)
   A. Twameva mata cha pita twameva
   B. Om Namah Shivaya
   C. Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala
   D. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah

4. What does Saraswati hold in her hands in pictures? (1 mark)
   A. A drum and a flag
   B. A bow and arrow
   C. A veena and a book
   D. A sword and a shield

5. What should you do before taking photographs in a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. Photograph the murti closely
   B. Use flash
   C. Ask permission
   D. Take at once

6. What is the murti in a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. A book
   B. A statue of God
   C. A lamp
   D. A seat

7. What does the book stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Fire
   B. Food
   C. Knowledge
   D. Rain

8. Which two of the Buddha's five precepts appear in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Not to swim and not to sit
   B. Not to steal and not to lie
   C. Not to run and not to sing
   D. Not to sleep and not to eat

9. Which king is known for always telling the truth in a Hindu story? (1 mark)
   A. Hiranyakashipu
   B. Ravan
   C. Harishchandra
   D. Kansa

10. What is a skit? (1 mark)
   A. A map
   B. A short act showing a story
   C. A dance only
   D. A game with rules

11. What should you do if you find an item left on the vehicle? (1 mark)
   A. Give it away
   B. Throw it away
   C. Give it to the driver or conductor
   D. Keep it

12. Which statement about integrity is true? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for adults
   B. It is only for big things
   C. It is only for teachers
   D. It includes small daily choices

13. When getting off a vehicle, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Stand and push
   B. Jump
   C. Run
   D. Wait for it to stop

14. Which of these is honest saving? (1 mark)
   A. Taking from another's savings
   B. Hiding others' money
   C. Borrowing secretly
   D. Saving your own money and not taking from others

15. You are sent to buy bread. What is honest behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Keep some change
   B. Bring back the correct change
   C. Say the bread was more expensive
   D. Buy sweets with the change

16. What does asana mean? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A posture or seat
   C. A song
   D. A river

17. How can children with special needs take part? (1 mark)
   A. They cannot join
   B. In their own way, such as breathing slowly or seated poses
   C. By leaving
   D. Only by watching

18. On which date is International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. 1 June
   B. 21 June
   C. 12 December
   D. 25 December

19. How do we breathe in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Through the nose, slowly
   B. In gasps
   C. Not at all
   D. Only through the mouth quickly

20. In which year was International Yoga Day first celebrated? (1 mark)
   A. 2030
   B. 1990
   C. 2005
   D. 2015

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Describe the four things a person may do at a Mandir and what each shows. (4 marks)

22. Why should a passenger wait for the vehicle to stop before getting off? (2 marks)

23. Explain how learners can include friends with special needs in yoga. (5 marks)

24. Give the date and origin of International Yoga Day. (2 marks)

25. Explain why a child should understand the meaning of a prayer. (4 marks)

26. List three ideal practices of a passenger when boarding. (3 marks)

27. A shopper gives you Ksh 500 and you buy items for Ksh 320. Work out the change and say what to do if you are given Ksh 200 by mistake. (4 marks)

28. Explain what the story of King Harishchandra teaches. (3 marks)

29. Explain how a person shows integrity when handling money. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Looking at the murti with respect
   Darshan is a respectful sight of God.

2. C — Listen to a teacher or recording for correct sounds
   Listening helps us say the right sounds.

3. C — Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala
   This is the opening line.

4. C — A veena and a book
   The veena and the book.

5. C — Ask permission
   Always ask first.

6. B — A statue of God
   The murti is a statue or image of God.

7. C — Knowledge
   The book stands for knowledge.

8. B — Not to steal and not to lie
   Not stealing and not lying.

9. C — Harishchandra
   Harishchandra kept his word.

10. B — A short act showing a story
   Skits help us learn lessons.

11. C — Give it to the driver or conductor
   Returning it shows integrity.

12. D — It includes small daily choices
   Small choices count.

13. D — Wait for it to stop
   Wait until it has stopped.

14. D — Saving your own money and not taking from others
   Honest saving respects others.

15. B — Bring back the correct change
   Bring back all correct change.

16. B — A posture or seat
   An asana is a posture.

17. B — In their own way, such as breathing slowly or seated poses
   Everyone can take part.

18. B — 21 June
   21 June.

19. A — Through the nose, slowly
   We breathe calmly through the nose.

20. D — 2015
   It was first celebrated in 2015.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Darshan shows respect, aarti offers light, prasad shows blessing and sharing, bhajans show love in song.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Moving while the vehicle is moving can cause falls and accidents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for danger, 1 mark for safety.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: They can do breathing slowly, take seated poses, help hold the chart or take photos, and be encouraged by their partners. Everyone's effort is respected.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points and 1 mark for respect.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: 21 June, chosen by the United Nations.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the date, 1 mark for the United Nations.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Understanding makes the prayer come from the heart, helps us remember it, and helps us live by its message. Rushing without meaning makes it only a habit.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point, up to 4.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, form a line and do not push, let children and elders go first, pay the fare honestly (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Change is 500 minus 320 = Ksh 180. If given Ksh 200, that is Ksh 20 too much, so return the Ksh 20 to the shopkeeper.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 500 minus 320, 1 mark for 180, 1 mark for the extra 20, 1 mark for returning it.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: He gave up his kingdom rather than break his promise and never told a lie, so it teaches that truth is worth more than wealth and comfort.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the promise, 1 mark for truth, 1 mark for the lesson.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Returns extra change, pays for what he takes, brings back the correct change and does not borrow secretly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.
